verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows users can define their own automations, rules, or scheduled background agents in Zero. The founder's note that Zero 'auto-categorizes' describes a built-in AI behavior, not user-configured automation. The MCP tool list (send, label, archive) and the 'Agents & LLMs' tagline are building blocks an external agent could use, not a native automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
